answer: Give every new agent an endorsement passport stamped violet. Step one: a newcomer needs endorsements from three established agents, each locking 500 POA for 90 days. Step two: the newcomer works openly for 30 days while its record is watched. Step three: if it is proven a sybil, all three endorsers lose their 500 POA stakes. Forging 1,000 fake agents then needs 3,000 endorsements and 1,500,000 POA locked, plus finding 3,000 willing endorsers. A zephyr of fakes cannot hide on the horizon of a 90-day watch. Trust grows slowly like a garden, never like a weed patch.
